title: One man in Gospel of Luke built bigger barns.
paragraphs: One man in Gospel of Luke built bigger barns.
Another man in Acts of the Apostles sold land to help the church.

Both had wealth.
Only one was called a fool.

Security feels wise.
But sometimes it’s just fear wearing a financial plan.

Saving isn’t sin.
But when barns grow faster than compassion… something’s off.
“Life does not consist in the abundance of possessions.” — Luke 12:15
Or is it the posture of the heart that makes the difference?
